purpose: Exploratory one-shot prompt adaptation: continue the existing project YOLOv8n PolypGen detector on the independently verified C1-C5 still-image training split using official Ultralytics training, rather than training a new architecture. Preserve the original initialization frame and confidence/IoU settings at evaluation; no later redetection, new confidence gate or threshold.
data: Reuse the previously verified independent-copy 1377-image C1-C5 training and 88-image C6 validation dataset with its exclusions and hashes. Training and validation use no priority-video labels; no exact decoded RGB overlap between the still set and 2225 video frames was found. Patient and neighboring-frame overlap remain unknown. The original checkpoint's training data are also unknown, so C6 is not a verified independent test for it. C6 is used for checkpoint selection.
training: First test one official Ultralytics one-epoch MPS smoke run on the existing verified six/three-image engineering subset, independently checking input isolation, class identity and updated weights. Then, if engineering checks pass, start from the unchanged project checkpoint, do not resume its optimizer, train 10 epochs at image size 640, batch 8, AdamW lr0=0.0001 and lrf=0.1, warmup_epochs=1, close_mosaic=0, seed 20261114, workers 0, deterministic requested, MPS, AMP disabled, caching disabled and no early stopping. Select the official best validation checkpoint on C6. Record complete source and data hashes and original metadata; deterministic MPS is not guaranteed bitwise reproducible.
evaluation: First compare original versus adapted detector on exactly the four archived automatic initialization frames with the same existing confidence 0.25, IoU 0.7, image size 640 and class 0. Crop the seq23 inset before inference; retain missing predictions as missing and never search later. Repeat CPU inference independently, freeze boxes before inspecting target labels and independently audit box overlap, labeled-empty false alarms and prompt masks. Also compare original and adapted detector on C6 under the same frozen inference settings; report C6 selection bias and original training overlap uncertainty. Use GT only for evaluation and explicit oracle, not inference. Full videos only if this checkpoint shows a credible balance of present-frame recall and labeled-empty false alarms against original and the checks pass.
limits: This is an exploratory fine-tune, not an independent patient-level test or a guarantee of improvement. Priority sequences and labels have been inspected in earlier work; the initial C6 validation was already used for an earlier detector pilot. Existing original detector may already have seen C6. Empty labels may be incomplete. No untrained attention modules, test-label selection, inference threshold tuning or new redetection.
